items.title: 68099_Erskine Hawkins oral history interview
items.q: He named the tune cause he had a dog he used to call Tippier.

ctx.x: Well, we was in Los Angeles. Bobby Smith, he penned that. And we, when he finished it, we rehearsed it out there.
He named the tune cause he had a dog he used to call Tippier. And that's where he got that "Tippin' In".

Well, we was playing it on those one nighters. On my way back to New York, I had to go through Chicago, so I called my office cause the more I played it and the more I heard it, I enjoyed it better. So, I called my office. I said make an engagement, a stopover at Victor in Chicago so I can record. You know, I said I've got something I want to record before I get to New York.
